subject: Simple class condition
notes: kb/Work PB571. SR8 is SR3's rule with the category escape - 'usage is display or national OR whose category is numeric' - and it is now stated that way in one predicate instead of as a hand-written USAGE BIT special case. Its diagnostic stays COBOL0844, which has reported it since the data increment, and conformance:cases/8.8.4.4-Simple-class-condition/class-numeric-on-bit pins it unchanged; the 85 golden's A line pins the admission side (a category-numeric DISPLAY operand). An operand that also breaks SR1 is reported against SR1, which runs first.
